name: Wellspring Lake
summary: In northern Teldrassil, Wellspring Lake’s waters flow north as corruption troubles the wildlife. Northeast of Darnassus, the lake once offered night elf fishermen a quiet retreat.

sections.title: A Tainted Refuge
sections.body:
Beneath Teldrassil’s canopy, Wellspring Lake lies between Darnassus and the Oracle Glade. Night elves once came to its clear waters to fish and sit in quiet thought. Springs deep within the World Tree feed the lake, whose waters flow north through the Wellspring River.

Now a blight troubles the surrounding wilds. Aggressive spiders, prowling nightsabers, and agitated timberlings roam the banks, making the shore dangerous for travelers.

aliases: how to get to wellspring lake
faq.answer: Wellspring Lake lies in northern Teldrassil, northeast of Darnassus and just southeast of the Oracle Glade.

faq.q: Where does the lake's water come from and go?
faq.answer: Natural springs deep within Teldrassil feed the lake. Its waters flow north into the Wellspring River, toward the edge of the tree.

faq.q: Why is the area around Wellspring Lake dangerous?
faq.answer: Corruption across the World Tree has driven local beasts mad. Nightsabers, giant webwood spiders, and corrupted timberling bark-spirits stalk the shore.

faq.q: Who used to gather at Wellspring Lake?
faq.answer: Local night elf fishermen once came to Wellspring Lake for quiet reflection and fishing. The recent blight has agitated the wildlife and made the shores dangerous.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, peaceful groves like Wellspring Lake turning into dangerous dens of beasts show how deeply something has gone wrong with their young World Tree.
As a druid, you can study the agitated timberlings and beasts near Wellspring Lake to understand the unnatural sickness spreading through Teldrassil’s waters and soil.
